data.title: Central Park Plaza
data.about:
Introducing Central Park Plaza - the crown jewel of Central Park apartments! Nestled in City Walk's core, this residential masterpiece in Dubai stands out with its unmatched blend of vibrant amenities and abundant natural surroundings. Select from a curated range of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, opulent townhouses, or majestic 3-storey penthouses, each infused with the epitome of luxury details.

Envision a dwelling where Dubai's finest is at arm's length, merging convenience with opulence. Central Park Plaza is more than a home; it embodies a lifestyle of luxury intertwined with natural splendor. Seize the chance to immerse in unmatched elegance - Step into Central Park Plaza, your envisioned luxury.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Luxurious Urban Comfort
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Nestled in the heart of City Walk
  • Premium Phase: The final and most luxurious phase of Central Park apartments
  • Diverse Choices: Ranges from 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, to luxurious townhouses and grand 3-storey penthouses
  • Exquisite Interiors: Adorned with the finest luxury fittings and finishes
  • Nature Meets Urban: The only residential offering in Dubai set amidst lush, natural greenery while offering urban amenities
  • Active Lifestyle: Boasts an unparalleled blend of vibrant, active-lifestyle amenities.
  • Easy Access: Prime Dubai attractions are just minutes away, ensuring unparalleled convenience.
  • Elevated Living: A harmonious blend of luxury urban living amidst nature's beauty.

location_tile.title: Prime Location Meets Scenic Vistas
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled between Al Wasl Road and Sheikh Zayed Road, Central Park Plaza at City Walk boasts a prime location. Designed with an emphasis on community, sharing, and fluidity, its unique urban blend and seamless connections elevate it as a standout neighborhood in the city.

AREAS NEARBY:

  • 02 minute walk - City Walk 
  • 2 minute drive - Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 10 minute drive - Dubai Mall
  • 10 minute drive - Jumeirah Beach
  • 20 minute drive - Dubai Airport

seo.metaDescription: Central Park Plaza by Meraas offers 1-4 BR apartments, townhouses, and penthouses in City Walk Dubai, surrounded by nature and rich amenities.
